newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek short money rates ease in late quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Greek short money rates ease in late quiet trade.

text.p: Greek depos and implied drachma rates from forex forwards fell 20 to 30 basis points for periods up to a month in late dealings and the central bank smoothed the market by draining overnight cash at 12.40 percent, dealers said.

"Shorts up to a month have fallen 20 to 30 basis points trading around the central bank's 12.40 percent bid in late lacklustre trade," the dealer said. "The market has turned long for a small amount."
Forex and bond markets were also quiet and trading activity subdued, dealers said.
The mark was quoted at 157.95/05 drachmas from Wednesday's 157.930 fix, the dollar at 243.59/69 drachmas from 243.400 and the Ecu at 303.89/99 from 304.200 drachmas.
"It is known that the central bank wants a higher ecu/drachma rate and will take advantage of the thin market to do just that," said a forex dealer.
